Validation passed with exit status 0.

**Definition quote**, verbatim from the "Reproducibility" section of my instructions:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

The section is present and reads as expected of the current rules, so I proceeded.

## Result

`output_evaluation.json` written and validated (`VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic`, exit 0).

**Score: 85 / 88** — fixed 96.6% (denominator 88), normalized 96.6% (adjusted denominator 88). No question excluded, so the two bases coincide.

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness (Q1–5) | 20 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content (Q6–10) | 21 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation (Q11–15) | 24 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility (Q16–20) | 20 / 21 |

Deductions: **Q1 = 4** (12 of 14 enumerated fields; `resources` and `parent_datasets` empty), **Q11 = 4** (conversions described by input/output format but no converter name, version or repo path), **Q18 = 4** (`discouraged_uses` empty with its substance supplied nowhere else, and social-impact analysis confined to re-identification).

**Applicability.** All four trigger conditions were resolved before scoring, each on fields outside the gated question's own set per the anti-circular rule: human subjects from `description`/`keywords`/`collection_mechanisms` (gates Q8, Q15); datasets shared from `page`, `distribution_formats.access_urls`, `third_party_sharing.is_shared` (Q10, Q17); software output from `external_resources` referencing `https://github.com/AI-READI` (Q11); collection-plus-shared (Q12, Q13). Zero N/A, `excluded_max_points: 0`.

**Semantic findings.** I recomputed every quantitative claim rather than accepting it. The file-count arithmetic reconciles exactly (356,334 + 9 root files = 356,343), the nine directory byte totals sum to precisely the figure the record states, with exactly the disclosed 419,614-byte residual, and all cohort, split and cross-split demographic tables reconcile to 2,280 without a discrepancy. Grant `OT2OD032644` parses as a valid NIH OT2/OD award matching its stated Bridge2AI programme; DOI prefixes are registrar-consistent (10.60775 FAIRhub, 10.5281 Zenodo, 10.1038, 10.1136). Ten issues recorded: 27 checks passed, 3 failed, 8 warnings. The three failures are the byte residual, the contradictory `sensitive_elements` booleans, and the empty `data_protection_impacts`.

Two judgement calls worth surfacing, since they cut opposite ways on superficially similar gaps. Q8 keeps 5 despite the empty `data_protection_impacts` because that field's substance is delivered by two other fields the same question names — `participant_privacy.reidentification_risk` and `future_use_impacts`. Q18 drops to 4 because `discouraged_uses` has no substitute anywhere: `prohibited_uses` states what is forbidden, not what is permitted but unwise, and this cohort is deliberately balanced rather than population-representative, which is precisely the misuse a discouraged-use note should catch.

Provenance recorded as instructed: `instrument_sha256` `9d08b5f3…0e7dd3` with `instrument_kind: agent_definition`, the supplied `rubric_hash` and `input_sha256`, `d4d_file` set to the `data/d4d_concatenated/...` path rather than the temporary input, `temperature: null`, and `claude-opus-5` as both `model.name` and `model.evaluator_model`.
